sql: select r.created_at, r.status, r.total, r.passed, r.failed, r.errors, r.cost_usd, (select string_agg(x.scenario_key || '=' || x.status || coalesce('[' || (select string_agg((c->>'id') || ': ' || left(c->>'note', 320), ' / ') from jsonb_array_elements(x.checks) c where c->>'ok' = 'false') || ']', '') || coalesce(' ERR:' || left(x.error, 100), ''), ' | ') from public.ai_sim_results x where x.run_id = r.id and x.status <> 'passed') as falhas from public.ai_sim_runs r order by r.created_at desc limit 1 offset 0
